name: Health
description: Activity totals from the system's health store, read only: steps, distance, active energy over a range, whole or by the hour / the calendar day, de-duplicated across the phone and the watch. Apple HealthKit on iOS, Health Connect on Android. No web half. The app's side is Health.

infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: The app reads your steps, distance and active energy from Health to show your activity.
